title: Extension core-object section describes removed feature
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely: all extension CSS/browser/server payload execution is gone; the Settings surface, client hooks, shared contract, and API routes were deleted; startup permanently erases every retained server record and extension-storage:* settings; authoring guides, examples, and Professor Mari instructions were removed.
fix: Delete the '### Extension' core-object section including the pointer to references/extensions.md, and replace with a short 'Removed in v2.3.4' note so ideation answers stop recommending extensions.

title: Big Picture diagram still shows Extensions client panel
reality: The client no longer has an extension surface; the Settings surface and client hooks were deleted in v2.3.4.
fix: Remove '- Extensions' from the Client box in the ASCII diagram.

title: Data Storage list still includes extensions
reality: v2.3.4 startup permanently erases every retained extension server record and extension-storage:* settings; the UI-state migration removes browser-local extension records. Extensions are no longer a stored object type.
fix: Change 'themes, extensions' to 'themes', and note that v2.3.4 startup purges legacy extension records and extension-storage:* settings.

title: 'What's NOT Built-In' claims CSS/JS extensions remain manual installs
reality: There is no extension mechanism at all in v2.3.4 — only themes and downloadable agent packages remain as customization paths.
fix: Rewrite: 'No third-party plugin marketplace — official capability packages install from the in-app Download Agents catalog. The client extension feature (CSS/JS) was removed entirely in v2.3.4; custom UI now means themes or forking.' Consider a dedicated 'No client extensions' bullet since this is recommendation-critical.

title: Conversation group turns described as single merged generation only
reality: v2.3.4 (#3887) added Grouped AND Individual response modes with sequential, smart, manual, mention-directed, and autonomous character selection, a shared daily check-in budget, and a token-use warning. Supersedes the v2.3.1 model.
fix: Rewrite the Group DMs line: Grouped (merged multi-speaker generation, split per-speaker bubbles retained from #3609) vs Individual response modes, five selection strategies, shared daily check-in budget, token-use warning (v2.3.4, #3887).

title: Mentions always select responders; Reply When Mentioned toggle removed
reality: v2.3.4 (#3891): Conversation character mentions always select the mentioned responder(s), including legacy manual-response chats; the redundant Reply When Mentioned toggle was removed.
fix: Add to the rewritten group-DM paragraph (#3891).

title: Check-in ceiling overrides and removed 50-message summary-tail ceiling missing
reality: v2.3.4 (#3864) added explicit numeric overrides for Conversation chat check-in ceilings and removed the 50-message ceiling from Conversation and Roleplay recent-summary tails, retaining conservative defaults and cost guidance.
fix: Append to the Chat Summary paragraph and mention the check-in overrides in the Conversation Mode section (#3864).

title: Noodle refresh: local time and character schedule attachment missing
reality: v2.3.4 (#3886): every Noodle timeline refresh now includes the user's current local time, plus an optional setting to attach participating characters' existing generated schedules for the current day.

title: Noodle local-model JSON robustness fixes missing
reality: v2.3.4: adjacent JSON objects are merged so all timeline collections are recovered (#3881) and single-object array wrappers accepted for profiles (#3871).
fix: Add a sentence to the Noodle Refresh paragraph (#3881, #3871).

title: Local ComfyUI video generation missing from video providers
reality: v2.3.4 (#3804) added local ComfyUI video generation for API-format WAN and other workflows, with prompt, size, seed, frame-count, and uploaded first-frame placeholders. The Video Generation section currently lists only five cloud service profiles, implying no local video path exists.
fix: Add ComfyUI as a local video backend to the 'Video Generation (v2.1)' bullet (#3804); note ComfyUI now covers video, not just images.

title: ComfyUI workflow guide not mentioned
reality: v2.3.4 (#3749) added an in-app and GitHub ComfyUI workflow guide covering API-format exports, Marinara placeholders, local and RunPod reference-image inputs, character-specific workflows, LAN setup, VRAM constraints, and troubleshooting.
fix: Add to the 'In-app Documentation viewer' bullet or the ComfyUI provider note (#3749).

title: Launcher read-only latest-release check when auto-update disabled
reality: v2.3.4: with automatic Engine updates disabled, the launchers perform a read-only latest-release check and print a console reminder (installed version + release-page link); --skip-update still suppresses all update checks for one launch.

title: Launchers no longer source .env as Bash
reality: v2.3.4 (#3810): the macOS/Linux and Termux launchers stopped sourcing .env as Bash code; launcher-owned settings use Node's non-evaluating dotenv parser while preserving ambient-environment precedence.
fix: Add a note near the env-var bullet (#3810) — relevant when troubleshooting launcher env issues.

title: SSE streaming survives tab-visibility changes
reality: v2.3.4: healthy SSE replies keep streaming after a backgrounded tab becomes visible again, using a grace period before falling back to the persisted full response only when the resumed stream makes no progress.
fix: Add to the /api/generate bullet or Special Features.

title: Prompt leaf content now verbatim (no HTML-escaping)
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in prompt leaf content: character card fields, persona, lorebook entries, memories, and scene text reach the model verbatim. Finalizes leaf content as verbatim; supersedes #3108 and the hardened-prompt-assembly card-text escaping; structural section wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers are unchanged.
fix: Add a v2.3.4 note to 'Prompt Assembly (Simplified)': leaf content is emitted verbatim (local single-user threat model); only structural wrappers and agent XML value/attribute escaping remain.

title: Cross-chat awareness bullet: hardcoded XML claim and stale UI location
reality: v2.3.4 (#3753): recalled memories, cross-chat awareness, connected Roleplay/Game context, and their command instructions honor the active Conversation preset's XML, Markdown, or unwrapped format. #3889 consolidated Cross-Chat Awareness under Connected Chats.
fix: Rewrite the cross-chat awareness bullet (#3753) and note the Connected Chats consolidation (#3889); update the Connected chats <influence>/<ooc> framing.

title: Character/Persona prompt section order outdated
reality: v2.3.4 (#3817): sections keep editor order across preset markers, fallbacks, agent lore, and Game/scene card contexts: Description, Personality, Backstory, Appearance, Scenario, then Example Dialogue. The Prompt Assembly outline lists 'Character description + personality + scenario' with examples as a separate later section.
fix: Update the preset-sections list to the fixed v2.3.4 order (#3817).

title: Scene-video endpoints now stream with byte-range/HEAD
reality: v2.3.4 (#3811): Roleplay and Game scene-video files are streamed with standard byte-range and HEAD handling.
fix: Append to the scene-video API bullet (#3811).

title: Macros list missing {{group}} and conditional operators
reality: v2.3.4 added the {{group}} prompt macro and conditional-macro operators: || (OR), && (AND), parentheses, and equality-list shorthand.
